title: Radio station
description: A Steadify radio station: who speaks, what segments an episode has, and the sentence banks the templated script writer picks from. Loaded as mod content type 'radio'. Code: Assets/Scripts/Radio/RadioStationDefinition.cs.

frequency.description: Shown on the dial, e.g. '88.3 FM'.

format.description: What the script writer builds; 'weather' is the almanac programme.

id.description: Referenced by lines as '{id}:' at the start of a line.

voice.description: Speaker id in the Kokoro voices file (kokoro-multi-lang-v1_0: 0..10 American female, 11..19 American male, 20..27 British; see docs/RADIO.md).

style.description: A few words on delivery; given to the Claude script writer.

persona.description: The programme's character, given to the Claude script writer.

lines.description: Sentence banks keyed by segment (plus conditional banks such as today_rain, frost, week_note_wet). Placeholders in braces are filled from the day's facts.

phrases.description: Named phrase tables keyed by season name.
